# Renox

> Renox is a batteries-included Rust web framework inspired by Laravel: Axum + HTMX + Alpine.js,
> with SQLite by default or PostgreSQL (the `postgres` feature). Apps depend on the `renox` crate
> and are managed with the `rnx` CLI. To do something the idiomatic way, open the one file listed
> for it below rather than reading the framework's source.

## Start here

- [CHEATSHEET.md](CHEATSHEET.md): the common patterns, 5–20 lines each and compiled as doctests:
  `rnx` commands; modules, routes, path parameters, route groups and guards (auth, verified,
  guest, throttle); views, template globals and overriding built-in pages; `App::share` and
  `App::templates`; `App::provide` and `App::layer`; forms and validation (`unique`/`exists`);
  models, migrations and queries (raw fragments, grouping, locks, update_or_create, simple and
  cursor pagination, transactions with retries); model keys other than integers (`Ulid`,
  `Uuid`, `String`, `rnx make:model --key`); every field type; pagination; data grids; seeders and factories; auth,
  policies, gates, API tokens and your own login; tenants (`renox::context`, default scopes),
  roles and permissions, route guards for gates/roles/permissions/token abilities; the account
  page, password rules and confirmation, per-device logout; auth events and the audit log;
  model hooks, partial saves (`save_only`, `save_changes`) and encrypted fields
  (`Encrypted<T>`); HTMX; raw SQL and transactions (savepoints); jobs (priority, unique, encrypted, middleware, chains, batches), events and
  the schedule (cron, weekly/monthly, weekdays, IANA time
  zones, `on_failure`, `schedule:run`); mail and notifications (with the in-app inbox); cookies
  and downloads; cache (`add`, `pull`, `increment`) and atomic locks; session, uploads and
  translations (plurals and ranges, the browser's language); session `push`/`increment`;
  factory states and sequences; domain and fallback routes, `Redirect::route`/`intended`,
  `route_is`, `class_names`, `{% break %}`; signed URLs and private files; CSP, CORS and
  webhooks; SEO and analytics; tests; form requests (`prepare`, `authorize`, `after`),
  `#[derive(Validate)]` and the full rule list; typed app commands
  (clap) and prompts; stacks (`push`/`stack`);
  Tailwind; errors, logs and debugging (request ids, JSON logs,
  `App::report`, named rate limiters, `/_renox/debug`); configuration (`.env` and your own
  settings).
- [README.md](README.md): install `rnx`, create and run an app, the generator commands.

## Examples (complete apps, tested in CI)

Every example has a README.md that walks through it.

- [examples/shop](examples/shop): a whole online shop, the example to read for how everything
  fits: catalog with htmx search, sort and pagination, a cached home page, SEO and a sitemap; a
  cart; checkout in one transaction that never oversells; an event whose listener queues the
  confirmation mail; notifications; a daily task cancelling unpaid orders; an admin for the
  `admin` role (the `Permissions` module, `require_role`) with photo uploads and an audit trail
  of order status changes (the `Audit` module), product delete behind password confirmation;
  checkout in `db.retrying`; en/id with plurals; the `make:deploy` files (with the systemd
  socket); every page on the UI kit with a rebranded accent, toasts and confirmation sheets
  (checkout: `toggle_buttons` + `show_when` + `required_if` for courier or pickup; the admin's
  category in a `select` whose options come from the server, added and renamed in place
  (`renox::select`, admin/categories.rs); its dashboard with `renox::chart` (`Period`,
  `Trend`), `period_filter`, `stats`/`stat`, `chart` line/bar/doughnut and a lazy, polled
  `widget`, then the kit's `tabs`/`tab_panel`; its product list with an "Adjust stock"
  `action_sheet` per row (admin/products.rs `adjust_stock`: `Toast` + `HxRefresh`, a
  `ValidationError` for its own check), `icon_button`s (one disabled with a reason), `n`
  for a new product and ⌘S / Ctrl+S on the form (`key=`); the
  order page an infolist with a `repeatable` of its lines; prices with the `money` filter; the
  `notification_bell` in its bar with `Auth::new().notifications()`, its notifications as
  `DatabaseMessage`s that arrive live over Server-Sent Events); a
  typed `shop:make-admin` command with a prompt; an admin nav marked with `route_is`; recently
  viewed products (`session.push`, `{% break %}`), stock texts with plural ranges,
  `class_names`, `Redirect::route`; tests with time travel (unpaid orders cancelled
  by the scheduled task), event and notification fakes and `assert_view`. Guide: its
  [README](examples/shop/README.md).
  - Checkout: [checkout.rs](examples/shop/src/app/orders/checkout.rs); orders, event, task:
    [orders/mod.rs](examples/shop/src/app/orders/mod.rs); admin:
    [admin/mod.rs](examples/shop/src/app/admin/mod.rs),
    [admin/products.rs](examples/shop/src/app/admin/products.rs),
    [admin/orders.rs](examples/shop/src/app/admin/orders.rs) (audit); roles:
    [lib.rs](examples/shop/src/lib.rs); tests:
    [tests/shop.rs](examples/shop/tests/shop.rs)
- [examples/htmx-recipes](examples/htmx-recipes) ([README](examples/htmx-recipes/README.md)): htmx + Alpine recipes, each a few attributes and
  a handler that answers with a fragment: modal form (HX-Trigger closes it), inline edit
  (`hx-patch`, Escape cancels), toggle, dropdown with delete (an empty row part, the open count out of band and a
  toast), infinite scroll
  (`revealed`), client-side tabs, `HxRefresh`, `HxRedirect`; an out-of-band count
  (`.fragment("row").also("count")`), `HxRetarget`/`HxReswap` for a duplicate, toasts over htmx.
  [src/app/tasks/mod.rs](examples/htmx-recipes/src/app/tasks/mod.rs),
  [views](examples/htmx-recipes/resources/views/tasks),
  [tests/recipes.rs](examples/htmx-recipes/tests/recipes.rs)
- [examples/grid](examples/grid) ([README](examples/grid/README.md)): a sales dashboard on one data grid
  (`renox::grid` + `renox/grid.html`): fills the screen with only the rows scrolling, three
  columns on a phone and all on a desktop, the column menu (per screen size, order, freeze left
  or right; kept per user or in the session), a filter per heading by kind (text with `%`,
  number ranges, a date range calendar, choices, tags), grouped headings, custom cells
  (`sparkline`, a progress bar, buttons), pages and sorting from the server; audit details
  under a row, cells and rows edited in place (`PATCH` + `Valid<OrderEdit>`), rows dragged
  into order (`RowOrder`), `/regions` with merged region and city cells, and exports (CSV,
  Excel with the `xlsx` feature, a print page for PDF), a search box, filter chips and rows
  that open their order, bulk actions on selected (or all matching) orders and a row menu,
  totals in the footer and grouping by region, status or paid with subtotals, cards on
  phones, badges, avatars, descriptions and copy buttons, the customer's tier and a notes
  count from other tables, an advanced filter, remembered filters and polling; `/follow-up`
  with two grids paging apart on one page (`prefix`), plus `link`, `tooltip`, `wrap`, `limit`,
  `sortable(false)`/`filterable(false)`, `per_page` and a `numeric()` related column.
  [src/app/orders/mod.rs](examples/grid/src/app/orders/mod.rs),
  [views](examples/grid/resources/views/orders),
  [tests/grid.rs](examples/grid/tests/grid.rs)
- [examples/relations](examples/relations) ([README](examples/relations/README.md)): a blog: belongs to, has many, many to many through a
  pivot (`Pivot::sync` from checkboxes, `inverse()`) with pivot columns (a pinned flag and
  timestamps: `attach_with`, `update_pivot`, `load_with_pivot`), a page loaded without N+1
  (`belongs_to`, `has_many`, `load_for`, `count_many`), `where_has`, a `group_by` + `select_as`
  report, likes on posts and comments through a polymorphic `Morph`, and reports as SQL joins
  with `fetch_as`; tests/queries.rs counts queries to prove no N+1.
  [src/app/blog/mod.rs](examples/relations/src/app/blog/mod.rs),
  [model.rs](examples/relations/src/app/blog/model.rs),
  [tests/blog.rs](examples/relations/tests/blog.rs)
- [examples/crud](examples/crud) ([README](examples/crud/README.md)): one resource end to end: model and migration, list with
  pagination, create and edit forms with validation, owner-only edit and delete through a policy,
  soft delete with a trash and restore, model hooks (`#[model(hooks)]`: a slug filled on save,
  a cached count forgotten), `save_changes` on update, and tests for each. It is the example of
  the UI kit (`renox/ui.html`: fields, table, confirmation sheet, menu), toasts, live validation
  (`data-live-validate`), `push`/`stack` and an error page in the layout. The form is
  `#[derive(Validate)]` with a `prepare` hook; `products:import` imports a CSV with a savepoint
  per line; the seeder uses factory states and a sequence.
  - Routes and handlers: [examples/crud/src/app/products/mod.rs](examples/crud/src/app/products/mod.rs);
    the import: [import.rs](examples/crud/src/app/products/import.rs)
  - Model, factory, policy: [model.rs](examples/crud/src/app/products/model.rs),
    [policy.rs](examples/crud/src/app/products/policy.rs)
  - Views: [index.html](examples/crud/resources/views/products/index.html),
    [form.html](examples/crud/resources/views/products/form.html),
    [layouts/app.html](examples/crud/resources/views/layouts/app.html),
    [errors/default.html](examples/crud/resources/views/errors/default.html)
  - Tests: [examples/crud/tests/products.rs](examples/crud/tests/products.rs)
- [examples/api](examples/api) ([README](examples/api/README.md)): a JSON API: tokens for a mobile app (`User::attempt`,
  `create_token_with` with abilities and an expiry, pruned nightly), Bearer auth,
  `require_ability` on reads and writes, a list with `cursor_paginate`, JSON bodies validated
  with 422 errors, JSON 401/403/404, CORS and a rate limit; products keyed by `Ulid`; tests with `assert_json_path` and
  time travel (token expiry, the rate limit's window). [src/app/products/mod.rs](examples/api/src/app/products/mod.rs),
  [tests/api.rs](examples/api/tests/api.rs)
- [examples/jobs](examples/jobs) ([README](examples/jobs/README.md)): an event whose listener queues a receipt mail (a mail template
  with a text version), a notification to admins by mail and in the database, and scheduled
  reports: daily on weekdays and weekly by `cron`, in `Asia/Jakarta`, with an `on_failure` alert,
  a cache lock against overlapping runs, and counts and sums done in SQL. The M20b queue:
  payment as a chain (charge → receipt → warehouse) with an encrypted, rate-limited charge job
  and its `failed` hook, receipts on a `high` queue, unique reminders, and monthly statements
  as a batch with an htmx progress bar. The charge calls the payment gateway with `state.http`
  (a sandbox route stands in for it; the tests use `app.fake_http()`), and the admin sees the
  queue dashboard. `App::report` posts errors to a chat webhook. Tests travel past backoffs
  and `UNIQUE_FOR`, and fake events and notifications. [src/app/orders/mod.rs](examples/jobs/src/app/orders/mod.rs),
  [payment.rs](examples/jobs/src/app/orders/payment.rs),
  [remind.rs](examples/jobs/src/app/orders/remind.rs),
  [statements.rs](examples/jobs/src/app/orders/statements.rs),
  [receipt.rs](examples/jobs/src/app/orders/receipt.rs),
  [new_order.rs](examples/jobs/src/app/orders/new_order.rs),
  [tests/orders.rs](examples/jobs/tests/orders.rs)
- [examples/teams](examples/teams) ([README](examples/teams/README.md)): a multi-tenant SaaS:
  teams with per-team roles on the pivot, the current team in `renox::context` (checked by a
  middleware), a `Project` model with a default scope that fails closed, `unscoped()` for the
  admin report and a command, project names unique per team, `gate_before` for super-admins,
  and a team secret in an `Encrypted<String>` field behind password confirmation; each team's
  public page on its own host (`Routes::domain`, `DomainParams`, a domain fallback); a form request
  (`MemberForm`: `prepare`, `authorize`, `after`) checked live (`data-live-validate`); "New
  team" as a `wizard` with a `repeater` of members (`invites[0][email]` → `Vec<Invite>`,
  `v.nested`, `after` per row); a project name with `datalist` suggestions; pages on the UI kit with confirmation sheets and toasts.
  [tenancy.rs](examples/teams/src/app/tenancy.rs),
  [projects/model.rs](examples/teams/src/app/projects/model.rs),
  [teams/mod.rs](examples/teams/src/app/teams/mod.rs),
  [tests/teams.rs](examples/teams/tests/teams.rs)
- [examples/uploads](examples/uploads) ([README](examples/uploads/README.md)): public photos checked by content, private invoices behind
  expiring signed links, `post_multipart` in tests; both forms on the kit's `file` field.
  [src/app/documents/mod.rs](examples/uploads/src/app/documents/mod.rs),
  [tests/documents.rs](examples/uploads/tests/documents.rs)
- [examples/postgres](examples/postgres) ([README](examples/postgres/README.md)): one app on PostgreSQL and SQLite (BOOLEAN and DATE
  columns, per-database migrations, case-insensitive search), tested on both.
  [src/app/tasks/mod.rs](examples/postgres/src/app/tasks/mod.rs),
  [migrations/](examples/postgres/migrations)
- [examples/fields](examples/fields) ([README](examples/fields/README.md)): every form field type (text, textarea, number, money,
  switch, radio → `DbEnum`, checkbox list → `Json<Vec<String>>`, time, datetime-local, date)
  on the UI kit (`prefix`/`suffix`, `radio`, `checkbox_list`, `date_picker`, a `copyable` key,
  `tags_input` → `Json<Vec<String>>`, `key_value` → `Json<KeyValues>` (a nested form),
  `form_grid`, `fieldset`)
  saved and shown back in the edit form, and read-only on the product page (an infolist:
  money, number, bool, badges, color swatches, key_value, Markdown, dates, `since`), on
  SQLite and PostgreSQL; list items checked
  with `each` + `one_of` and `distinct`; products keyed by `id: Uuid` (a model key other than
  an integer, M22). The mapping table is
  [docs/types.md](docs/types.md). [src/app/products/mod.rs](examples/fields/src/app/products/mod.rs),
  [form.html](examples/fields/resources/views/products/form.html),
  [show.html](examples/fields/resources/views/products/show.html),
  [tests/products.rs](examples/fields/tests/products.rs)
- [examples/webhooks](examples/webhooks) ([README](examples/webhooks/README.md)): payment gateway webhooks marking orders paid:
  Midtrans, Xendit and Stripe signatures, stored once per event, processed in the queue.
  - One file per provider: [midtrans.rs](examples/webhooks/src/app/payments/midtrans.rs),
    [xendit.rs](examples/webhooks/src/app/payments/xendit.rs),
    [stripe.rs](examples/webhooks/src/app/payments/stripe.rs); tests:
    [tests/payments.rs](examples/webhooks/tests/payments.rs)
- [examples/hello](examples/hello) ([README](examples/hello/README.md)): a guestbook in one file: HTMX form posts that return
  fragments, a photo upload, an event whose listener queues a mail job, a scheduled task,
  i18n (en/id) with a language switch and the browser's language (`detect_locale`), a
  `#[derive(Validate)]` form, login with the account page, a seeder, and a typed
  `entries:prune` command that confirms (tested with time travel and `prompt::answering`).
  - [examples/hello/src/lib.rs](examples/hello/src/lib.rs),
    [tests](examples/hello/tests/guestbook.rs)

## Guides

- [docs/postgresql.md](docs/postgresql.md): PostgreSQL apps, migrations per database, SQL that runs
  on both, tests with `TEST_DATABASE_URL`, moving data from SQLite.
- [docs/operations.md](docs/operations.md): running in production: logs (JSON, files, request
  ids), error reports (`App::report`), error pages, the debug inspector, deploys without refused
  connections (systemd socket activation), database sessions, timeouts, `TRUSTED_PROXIES`,
  `/health`, what happens when the database or SMTP fails, recovering failed jobs and webhook
  calls, backups (and what `APP_KEY` protects), migrations at deploy, the scheduler's time zone,
  tables to prune, maintenance mode.
- [docs/development.md](docs/development.md): faster builds (profiles, linker, features to drop,
  sccache, the cargo-chef Dockerfile).
- [docs/types.md](docs/types.md): every Rust field type with its form input and its SQLite and
  PostgreSQL column (`DbEnum`, `Json<T>`, dates and times, money, UUID).
- [docs/authorization.md](docs/authorization.md): which tool answers which question (gates,
  policies, the `Permissions` module, `gate_before`, token abilities, tenants with default
  scopes and `renox::context`, password confirmation, the audit log), mapped to Laravel's.
- [docs/testing.md](docs/testing.md): `TestApp` requests and assertions (JSON paths, views,
  session, login), the database, jobs, event and notification fakes, HTTP fakes, time travel,
  counting queries, a browser-test recipe.
- [docs/ui.md](docs/ui.md): components that see the request, the UI kit (`renox/ui.html`: fields,
  buttons, cards, sheets, menus, tabs, tables, infolists: `infolist`/`entry`/`repeatable`),
  the filters `number`, `money` (`APP_CURRENCY`), `date`, `since`, `words`, `markdown`,
  dashboards (`renox::chart`: `Period`, `Trend`, `Series`; `chart(…)`, `stat`, `stats`,
  `dashboard`, `widget`, `period_filter`), and its
  design rules, toasts (a body, links, a duration, an id, a position, `Renox.toast`), out-of-band
  fragments, htmx headers, live validation.
- [docs/grid.md](docs/grid.md): data grids (`renox::grid` + `renox/grid.html`): columns and their
  kinds, filters per heading, search, filter chips, the advanced filter, preferences (per user
  or in the session), details under a row, editing in place, reordering rows, merged cells,
  bulk and row actions, summaries and groups, cards on phones, columns from related tables,
  exports (CSV, Excel with `xlsx`, print), polling.
- [docs/validation.md](docs/validation.md): forms and validation: `Valid<T>` (form, JSON,
  query), `impl Validate` and `#[derive(Validate)]`, every rule, `unique`/`exists`, password
  policy, hooks (`prepare`/`authorize`/`after`), messages and translations, uploads as fields.
- [docs/routing.md](docs/routing.md): routes, groups, resources, domains, extractors and
  responses, middleware and guards, rate limits, sessions, CSRF, cookies, signed URLs,
  maintenance mode.
- [docs/mail.md](docs/mail.md): mail (drivers, views, attachments, queued mail, the preview) and
  notifications (mail, database, custom channels, `DatabaseMessage`, the in-app inbox and the
  kit's live notification bell (`Auth::new().notifications()`, Server-Sent Events), pruning,
  testing).
- [docs/scheduling.md](docs/scheduling.md): the scheduler (cron, time zones, several servers,
  housekeeping tasks), events and listeners, the cache and locks, app commands and prompts.
- [docs/queue.md](docs/queue.md): jobs, retries and `failed`, `dispatch_in`, priority, unique
  jobs, middleware (overlap, rate limits), encrypted payloads, chains and batches with
  progress, the dashboard, testing jobs; mapped to Laravel's.
- [docs/relations.md](docs/relations.md): relations without N+1 (`belongs_to`, `has_many`, `Pivot`
  with pivot columns, polymorphic `Morph`), keys other than integers (`Pivot<Ulid, i64>`), joins
  with `fetch_as` and `#[derive(FromRow)]`, the query builder mapped to Laravel's.
- [docs/stability.md](docs/stability.md): what semver covers, which types may grow
  (`#[non_exhaustive]`), public dependencies (axum yes, sqlx only through escape hatches).
- `rnx make:deploy` writes `deploy/README.md` (Docker, systemd, Litestream backups).

## Where things are (for changing Renox itself)

- [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md) (same as AGENTS.md): the contributor and agent guide, including the
  architecture, conventions, and problems already solved.
- [ROADMAP.md](ROADMAP.md): milestones and design decisions.
- [docs/audit/2026-09-pre-1.0.md](docs/audit/2026-09-pre-1.0.md): known issues (IDs W*, D*, A*) from
  the pre-1.0 audit, with repro tests and fix directions; ROADMAP M13/M14 track them.
- [docs/audit/2026-09-laravel-parity.md](docs/audit/2026-09-laravel-parity.md): the Laravel
  parity review behind M18–M21, and a later gap report
  ([PDF](docs/audit/2026-09-laravel-gap-report.pdf), in Indonesian).
- `crates/renox-core/src`: the runtime. `db/` (Db, models, queries, relations, migrations),
  `validation/`, `auth/` (incl. `permissions.rs`, `account.rs`, `events.rs`, `tokens.rs`),
  `audit.rs`, `context.rs`, `queue/`, `schedule.rs` + `timezone.rs`, `cache.rs`, `view.rs`,
  `grid/` (the data grid and its exports), `testing.rs`.
- `crates/renox-cli`: `rnx`; `stubs/` holds the files `rnx new` writes.
